from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from typing import Any, Optional

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SalesEvent:
    """Immutable record of one sales fact."""
    event_id: str                           # string, PRIMARY KEY, globally unique (UUIDv7 / ULID)
    product_id: str                         # string, FK -> product dimension
    revenue: Decimal                        # decimal(18,4), SIGNED (negative = refund/rebate)
    event_time: datetime                    # ISO-8601, tz-aware, BUSINESS time (when sale occurred)
    processing_time: Optional[datetime] = None  # ISO-8601, tz-aware, RUNTIME-POPULATED

# Field-level spec (also the wire contract)

    "event_id":        {"type": "string",   "format": "uuid|ulid", "nullable": False,
                        "producer": "required", "role": "primary key / idempotency key"},
    "product_id":      {"type": "string",   "format": "non-empty", "nullable": False,
                        "producer": "required", "role": "dimension FK"},
    "revenue":         {"type": "decimal",  "precision": 18, "scale": 4, "nullable": False,
                        "producer": "required", "role": "measure; NEVER use float/binary FP"},
    "event_time":      {"type": "timestamp","format": "ISO-8601 w/ offset, normalized to UTC",
                        "nullable": False, "producer": "required",
                        "role": "event-time clock -> all windowing/watermarks"},
    "processing_time": {"type": "timestamp","format": "ISO-8601 w/ offset, UTC",
                        "nullable": True,  "producer": "RUNTIME ONLY (must be absent/null at ingress)",
                        "role": "processing-time clock; non-deterministic, non-reproducible"},
}

# Wire formats

    "title": "sales_event", "type": "object", "additionalProperties": False,
    "required": ["event_id", "product_id", "revenue", "event_time"],
    "properties": {
        "event_id":        {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
        "product_id":      {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
        "revenue":         {"type": "string", "pattern": r"^-?\d{1,14}(\.\d{1,4})?$",
                            "description": "decimal as STRING on the wire (avoid FP loss)"},
        "event_time":      {"type": "string", "format": "date-time"},
        "processing_time": {"type": ["string", "null"], "format": "date-time"},
    },

    "fields": [
        {"name": "event_id",   "type": "string",  "logicalType": "uuid"},
        {"name": "product_id", "type": "string"},
        {"name": "revenue",    "type": {"type": "bytes", "logicalType": "decimal",
                                        "precision": 18, "scale": 4}},
        {"name": "event_time", "type": {"type": "long", "logicalType": "timestamp-millis"}},
        {"name": "processing_time", "type": ["null", {"type": "long",
                                      "logicalType": "timestamp-millis"}], "default": None},
    ],
}

    "mutability": "APPEND-ONLY",
    "detail": {
        "updates":     "NOT SUPPORTED — a fact is never mutated in place",
        "deletes":     "NOT SUPPORTED — no row-level deletes on the source stream",
        "retractions": "NOT SUPPORTED — no retract/upsert ('-U') changelog records",
        "corrections": ("corrections are expressed as NEW, additional events "

                        "Ledger semantics: revenue = SUM(revenue) over all events."),
    },
    "primary_key": "event_id",
    "delivery_guarantee": "at-least-once",
    "deduplication": {
        "required_at": "consumer",
        "key": "event_id",
        "policy": "first-write-wins; replays of the same event_id are no-ops",
        "note": "event_id must be stable across producer retries",
    },
    "ordering": {
        "event_time": "TOTAL ORDER NOT GUARANTEED — events may arrive out of order",
        "guarantee":  "per-partition FIFO only (partition by product_id)",
        "processing_time": "monotonically non-decreasing per partition by construction",
    },
    "time_semantics": {
        "event_time": "authoritative for windowing, joins, and all business reporting; "
                      "fully deterministic and reproducible on replay",
        "processing_time": "assigned by the runtime at ingestion (or at the moment a window "
                           "fires); used ONLY for latency metrics, watermarks, and late-data "
                           "classification. NEVER used in business aggregates.",
        "invariant": "processing_time >= event_time for every event",
    },
    "windowing": {
        "type": "tumbling, event-time",
        "window": "1 hour (tunable)",
        "allowed_lateness": "event_time >= processing_time - 2 hours",
        "late_events": ("events older than the allowed-lateness bound are NOT dropped; "
                        "they are routed to a side output / revised-window path and "
                        "windows may re-emit with a new revision marker"),
    },
    "completeness": "no end-of-stream marker; results are speculative until watermark passes",
    "levels_of_consistency": "at-least-once end-to-end; exactly-once requires idempotent sink keyed on event_id",

## 2. Validate a sample stream against the contract

```python
import re
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation

TS = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"
REV_RE = re.compile(r"^-?\d{1,14}(\.\d{1,4})?$")

def _ts(v):
    return datetime.strptime(v.replace("Z", "+0000"), TS)

def validate(raw: dict, runtime_now: datetime | None = None) -> SalesEvent:
    keys = set(raw)
    extra = keys - {"event_id", "product_id", "revenue", "event_time", "processing_time"}
    assert not extra, f"additionalProperties not allowed: {extra}"
    assert raw.get("event_id", "").strip(), "event_id required, non-empty"
    assert raw.get("product_id", "").strip(), "product_id required, non-empty"
    rev = raw["revenue"]
    assert isinstance(rev, str) and REV_RE.match(rev), f"revenue malformed: {rev!r}"
    d = Decimal(rev)                          # Decimal, never float
    assert -(10 ** 14) < d < 10 ** 14, "revenue out of precision(18,4) range"
    et = _ts(raw["event_time"])               # -> tiny offset
    pt = raw.get("processing_time")
    pt = et if pt is None else _ts(pt)        # runtime populates when absent
    assert pt >= et, f"invariant violated: processing_time {pt} < event_time {et}"
    return SalesEvent(raw["event_id"], raw["product_id"], d, et, pt)

# Three realistic cases: normal, retry-replay, refund-correction
raw_stream = [
    {"event_id": "018f2a3b-0000-7000-8000-000000000001", "product_id": "SKU-1001",
     "revenue": "19.99",   "event_time": "2026-10-12T09:15:00Z"},
    {"event_id": "018f2a3b-0000-7000-8000-000000000001", "product_id": "SKU-1001",
     "revenue": "19.99",   "event_time": "2026-10-12T09:15:00Z"},   # duplicate replay
    {"event_id": "018f2a3b-0000-7000-8000-000000000002", "product_id": "SKU-1001",
     "revenue": "-19.99",  "event_time": "2026-10-12T11:40:00Z",     # late-arriving refund
     "processing_time": "2026-10-12T12:05:00Z"},
]

env = []
for raw in raw_stream:
    try:
        env.append(validate(raw))
    except AssertionError as e:
        print("REJECT:", e)

# Dedup on event_id -> first-write-wins
seen, deduped = set(), []
for e in env:
    if e.event_id not in seen:
        seen.add(e.event_id); deduped.append(e)

# Event-time aggregate (ledger sums, corrections net out)
from collections import defaultdict
ledger = defaultdict(Decimal)
for e in deduped:
    key = (e.product_id, e.event_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:00Z"))
    ledger[key] += e.revenue

print(f"{'product':<10}{'event_hour':<22}{'revenue':>10}")
for (p, h), v in sorted(ledger.items()):
    print(f"{p:<10}{h:<22}{v:>10}")

# Late-data check (2h allowed lateness, processing-time judged)
for e in deduped:
    lateness = e.processing_time - e.event_time
    print(f"{e.event_id[-4:]}  lateness={lateness}  "
          f"{'LATE->side-output' if lateness > timedelta(hours=2) else 'on-time'}")

Create a bounded input multiset of 12 sales events for products P1, P2, and P3. Use event times between 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z and 2025-01-01T00:10:00Z. Include at least one event with a duplicate event_id and one event with a negative revenue value to represent a correction.

I'll build a self-contained, bounded multiset (a *multiset*, not a set — so one `event_id` deliberately repeats), validate every record against the schema/contract from the previous step, then show how the duplicate and the negative correction net out.

```python
import re
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

# ---------------- bounded input window: closed interval ----------------
WINDOW_START = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
WINDOW_END   = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 10, 0)

def parse_ts(s: str) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00")).replace(tzinfo=None)

# ---------------- the 12-event multiset ----------------
# (arrival_order, event_id, product_id, revenue, event_time)
# arrival order is NOT event-time order -> exercises the ordering contract
records = [
    (1,  "evt-003", "P3", "7.25",   "2025-01-01T00:02:00Z"),
    (2,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),
    (3,  "evt-007", "P1", "-10.00", "2025-01-01T00:06:00Z"),   # CORRECTION (negative)
    (4,  "evt-002", "P2", "25.50",  "2025-01-01T00:01:15Z"),
    (5,  "evt-005", "P2", "4.99",   "2025-01-01T00:04:05Z"),
    (6,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),   # DUPLICATE event_id
    (7,  "evt-004", "P1", "12.00",  "2025-01-01T00:03:20Z"),
    (8,  "evt-010", "P3", "21.10",  "2025-01-01T00:08:55Z"),
    (9,  "evt-006", "P3", "8.75",   "2025-01-01T00:05:10Z"),
    (10, "evt-009", "P3", "3.50",   "2025-01-01T00:07:30Z"),
    (11, "evt-011", "P2", "6.40",   "2025-01-01T00:09:40Z"),
    (12, "evt-008", "P2", "15.00",  "2025-01-01T00:06:45Z"),
]

raw = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["arrival_order", "event_id", "product_id",
                                     "revenue", "event_time_raw"])
raw["event_time"] = raw["event_time_raw"].map(parse_ts)
raw["revenue"]    = raw["revenue"].map(Decimal)   # Decimal, never float
raw = raw.drop(columns=["event_time_raw"])

# ingestion: processing_time is ABSENT at ingress (runtime-populated per contract)
assert "processing_time" not in raw.columns

# ---------------- validate every record ----------------
REV_RE = re.compile(r"^-?\d{1,14}(\.\d{1,4})?$")

def validate(row) -> list[str]:
    errs = []
    if not str(row.event_id).strip():
        errs.append("event_id empty")
    if not str(row.product_id).strip():
        errs.append("product_id empty")
    if not isinstance(row.revenue, Decimal):
        errs.append("revenue not Decimal")
    elif not Decimal("-99999999999999.9999") < row.revenue < Decimal("99999999999999.9999"):
        errs.append("revenue out of precision(18,4)")
    if not (WINDOW_START <= row.event_time <= WINDOW_END):
        errs.append(f"event_time {row.event_time} outside bounded window")
    return errs

raw["validation_errors"] = raw.apply(validate, axis=1)
print("records:", len(raw), "| distinct event_id:", raw.event_id.nunique(),
      "| invalid:", (raw.validation_errors.str.len() > 0).sum())
print(raw.to_string(index=False))

WIN_SIZE         = timedelta(minutes=2)      # TUMBLE(event_time, INTERVAL '2' MINUTE), epoch-aligned
WM_DELAY         = timedelta(seconds=30)     # bounded out-of-orderness (set in prior step)
ALLOWED_LATENESS = timedelta(minutes=5)      # window state retained this long past window_end
ACCUMULATION     = "ACCUMULATING_AND_RETRACTING"   # each pane = retract(old) + emit(new)
TRIGGER          = ("EventTimeTrigger(WM >= window_end) "          # exactly one ON-TIME pane
                    "+ late re-fire per element while WM < end+allowed_lateness "
                    "+ FINAL at WM >= end+allowed_lateness / end-of-input "
                    "[early panes disabled for this replay]")

EPOCH = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
def win_start(t):
    secs = (t - EPOCH).total_seconds()
    return EPOCH + timedelta(seconds=(secs // WIN_SIZE.total_seconds()) * WIN_SIZE.total_seconds())

# ------------------------------- input (bounded multiset) ----------------------
records = [
    (1,  "evt-003", "P3", "7.25",   "2025-01-01T00:02:00Z"),
    (2,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),
    (3,  "evt-007", "P1", "-10.00", "2025-01-01T00:06:00Z"),
    (4,  "evt-002", "P2", "25.50",  "2025-01-01T00:01:15Z"),
    (5,  "evt-005", "P2", "4.99",   "2025-01-01T00:04:05Z"),
    (6,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),   # duplicate
    (7,  "evt-004", "P1", "12.00",  "2025-01-01T00:03:20Z"),
    (8,  "evt-010", "P3", "21.10",  "2025-01-01T00:08:55Z"),
    (9,  "evt-006", "P3", "8.75",   "2025-01-01T00:05:10Z"),
    (10, "evt-009", "P3", "3.50",   "2025-01-01T00:07:30Z"),
    (11, "evt-011", "P2", "6.40",   "2025-01-01T00:09:40Z"),
    (12, "evt-008", "P2", "15.00",  "2025-01-01T00:06:45Z"),
]
tsf = lambda s: datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00")).replace(tzinfo=None)

raw = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["arrival", "event_id", "product_id", "revenue", "t"])
raw["event_time"] = raw["t"].map(tsf)
raw["revenue"]    = raw["revenue"].map(Decimal)
raw = raw.drop(columns="t").sort_values("arrival").reset_index(drop=True)
deduped = raw.drop_duplicates("event_id", keep="first").reset_index(drop=True)   # contract: PK dedup

# ================= simulate streaming: watermark -> trigger -> panes ===========
state, panes, log = {}, [], []
max_et = None
def wm():
    return None if max_et is None else max_et - WM_DELAY

def advance(wm_val, at, source):
    """Evaluate window triggers in order: fire ON-TIME, then close FINAL."""
    for w in sorted(state):
        s, we = state[w], state[w] and None
        we = w + WIN_SIZE
        if wm_val is not None and not s["fired"] and wm_val >= we:
            s["fired"] = True; s["pane"] += 1
            panes.append(dict(at=at, source=source, window=w, pane=s["pane"],
                              trigger="WM >= window_end", kind="ON-TIME",
                              value=s["agg"], n_elems=len(s["elems"]),
                              elems=", ".join(s["elems"])))
        if s["fired"] and not s["gc"] and wm_val is not None and wm_val >= we + ALLOWED_LATENESS:
            s["gc"] = True
            panes.append(dict(at=at, source=source, window=w, pane=s["pane"],
                              trigger="WM >= end + allowed_lateness", kind="FINAL",
                              value=s["agg"], n_elems=len(s["elems"]),
                              elems=", ".join(s["elems"])))

for r in deduped.itertuples():
    et = r.event_time
    w  = win_start(et); we = w + WIN_SIZE
    wm_before = wm()
    max_et = et if max_et is None else max(max_et, et)
    wm_after = wm()
    behind = wm_before is not None and et < wm_before

    s = state.setdefault(w, dict(agg=Decimal(0), pane=0, fired=False, gc=False, elems=[]))
    if s["gc"]:
        action = "DROPPED -> side output (past allowed lateness)"
    else:
        s["agg"] += r.revenue; s["elems"].append(r.event_id)
        if s["fired"]:
            s["pane"] += 1
            panes.append(dict(at=r.arrival, source=f"late {r.event_id}", window=w, pane=s["pane"],
                              trigger="late element", kind="LATE (retract+update)",
                              value=s["agg"], n_elems=len(s["elems"]),
                              elems=", ".join(s["elems"])))
            action = f"LATE -> emit revision #{s['pane']}"
        else:
            action = "behind WM, window still open" if behind else "in-order (buffered)"

    log.append(dict(arrival=r.arrival, event_id=r.event_id, pid=r.product_id, rev=r.revenue,
                    event_time=et, wm_before=wm_before, wm_after=wm_after,
                    window=w, behind_wm=behind, action=action))
    advance(wm_after, r.arrival, f"after arr {r.arrival}")

advance(datetime(9999, 1, 1), "EOI", "end-of-input flush")   # final watermark -> +inf

# --------------------------------- presentation --------------------------------
h = lambda t: "—" if (t is None or pd.isna(t)) else t.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
logdf = pd.DataFrame(log)
logdf["window"] = logdf.window.dt.strftime("%H:%M–") + (logdf.window + WIN_SIZE).dt.strftime("%H:%M")
print("ARRIVAL LOG".center(118, "="))
print(logdf.assign(event_time=logdf.event_time.dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
                   wm_before=logdf.wm_before.map(h), wm_after=logdf.wm_after.map(h))
      [["arrival","event_id","pid","rev","event_time","wm_before","wm_after","window",
        "behind_wm","action"]].to_string(index=False))

pdf = pd.DataFrame(panes)
pdf["window_lbl"] = pdf.window.dt.strftime("%H:%M–") + (pdf.window + WIN_SIZE).dt.strftime("%H:%M")
print("\n" + "PANE EMISSIONS".center(118, "="))
print(pdf.assign(value=pdf.value.map(lambda d: f"{d:+.2f}"))
      [["at","window_lbl","pane","kind","trigger","value","n_elems","elems"]]
      .to_string(index=False))

final = (pdf[pdf.kind == "FINAL"].set_index("window")["value"])
print("\nfinal (authoritative) sum per window:")
for w, v in final.items():
    print(f"  [{w.strftime('%H:%M')}, {(w+WIN_SIZE).strftime('%H:%M')})  {v:>+8.2f}")
print(f"  {'TOTAL':>22}  {final.sum():>+8.2f}  (equals deduped grand total)")
